name: pSemi
old_description: PE42424 SPDT delivers high linearity and fast switching for the range, speed and accuracy of Wi-Fi and UWB in a 1.5 x 1.5 mm package.
about:
pSemi is a semiconductor company headquartered in Arlington Heights, Illinois, that develops radio-frequency and power-management integrated circuits for connected devices.

The company designs and supplies a range of RF switches, front-end modules, and DC-DC buck converters built on its proprietary RF-SOI and HaRP™ technology platforms. Product examples include the PE42424 SPDT switch for Wi-Fi 6E and UWB, the PE566212 and PE566213 fully integrated 2.4 GHz FEMs for Bluetooth, Zigbee, and Thread, and the PE26100 multi-level buck converter supporting USB-PD fast charging up to 6 A. pSemi also co-developed a 5G antenna-integrated module with Murata for millimeter-wave beamforming.

pSemi serves markets including mobile, automotive, consumer, communication infrastructure, cable, broadband, Internet of Things, and instrumentation and measurement. Its automotive-grade switches are qualified to AEC-Q100 Grade 2 for operation up to 105 °C, and extended-temperature devices cover −55 °C to +125 °C.

The company emphasizes its HaRP™ technology for reducing gate lag and insertion-loss drift, monolithic CMOS integration of RF, analog, and digital functions, and a proven track record in top-tier smartphones. It participates in 3GPP and other industry standards bodies.
